lessons.title: Create the Next.js App
lessons.why: Here’s the simple reason this matters: This lesson is about Create the Next.js App. Keep the idea practical: in the Next.js TaskFlow web application, the worked example should show that next.js scaffolds the app, the development server starts, and the local URL renders without a build error. Once you can explain why that happens, the name is much easier to remember. We connect it to the course project so you can see the idea working instead of memorizing a definition.
objectives: Explain Create the Next.js App in terms of inputs, owner, outputs, and failure modes.
Implement Create the Next.js App incrementally and predict observable evidence before execution.
Diagnose a controlled Create the Next.js App failure from evidence.
Apply Create the Next.js App to a new TaskFlow requirement without copying the reference implementation.

mentalModel: This lesson is about Create the Next.js App. Keep the idea practical: in the Next.js TaskFlow web application, the worked example should show that next.js scaffolds the app, the development server starts, and the local URL renders without a build error.
